purpose: Source-only investigation of deposited phage length/terminal representation; no phenotype analysis or sequence alteration
known_prior_observations: 96 metadata-matched FASTAs exceed listed Genome_size (95 by 60 bases, LF110_P4 by 62); all 97 inspected FASTAs have identical first/last 60-base strings. This follow-up is not blind or prospectively independent of those observations.
source_scope: Every pinned blob under data/genomics/phages/FNA/ ending .fna; expect 97 source files, 96 exact metadata-name matches and one source lacking a metadata row
terminal_comparison: For each retained source sequence, enumerate every exact prefix/suffix match length from 1 through 120 bases, inclusive. Report lengths only; do not export nucleotide strings.
ambiguity_summary: Count leading/trailing N runs and total N/non-ACGT bases; inspect whether ambiguity explains length differences without deleting bases.
empty_record_policy: Only the pre-reviewed exact-hash-bound T4LD leading empty record can be skipped for sequence inspection; retain raw file and all sequence bases.
interpretation: Terminal overlap and metadata agreement are representation diagnostics; they do not identify natural termini, authorize trimming, authenticate experimental stock identity, or establish circularization. Owning-source generation rationale must be documented separately.
